visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen comparison of a muscular man in a gym setting. On the left, labeled 'Before,' he has a fit but less defined physique. On the right, labeled 'After,' his muscles are significantly more defined and vascular. He wears a black tank top and a baseball cap. (2) Transition to a medium shot of the same man speaking directly to the camera in a studio with gym equipment and a 'KEEP UP YOUR GAME' sign in the background. He uses hand gestures to emphasize his points. Large yellow text '3個重點' and '1個月 -5% 體脂' are overlaid. (3) The scene shifts to a screen recording of the FitHub mobile app, displaying nutritional progress bars for protein, carbs, and fat. (4) A hand holds a smartphone, using its camera to identify a banana resting on a green surface outdoors. (5) Another POV shot shows the phone camera scanning the nutritional facts table on a plastic bag of food or supplement. (6) A hand is shown typing 'pork' into the app's search bar while sitting at a restaurant table with plates of raw meat and vegetables. (7) The man returns to the screen, speaking enthusiastically. (8) A phone screen displays sleep data with a high score of 85 and a 'Sleep King' label. (9) The man is shown performing heavy cable rows in a dimly lit gym, followed by a shot of him walking briskly on a treadmill. (10) The video concludes with the man back in the studio, giving a thumbs-up to the camera with a confident expression.

[Subtitle]: 只要熱量跟蛋白質可以控制好. (4) [Slogan]: Fithub APP. [Subtitle]: 我每天都是用 Fithub APP. (5) [Slogan]: 每日熱量 TDEE x 0.8 (kcal). [Slogan]: 蛋白質 > 體重 x 2 (g). (6) [Slogan]: FitHub 建議營養素攝取. (7) [Slogan]: 多種方式幫你記錄熱量. (8) [Slogan]: 2 睡眠品質. [Subtitle]: 第二就是你的睡眠品質一定要夠好. (9) [Logo]: PEETA+ 超高分! 睡眠大王. (10) [Slogan]: 3 一定要運動. [Subtitle]: 第三就是一定要去運動.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular East Asian male with short hair, wearing a black 'VERVE' branded tank top and a dark baseball cap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a professional fitness studio with dark walls and motivational text. Secondary backgrounds include a gym with weight machines, a restaurant with food on the table, and an outdoor green court area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat begins. A male voice starts narrating with a crisp, professional tone. (2) A 'ping' sound effect occurs as technical text appears visually. (3) A sharp digital 'click' mimicking a camera shutter is heard during the food identification sequence. (4) Rapid digital UI 'tapping' sounds coincide with the app interaction. (5) A resonant 'ding' SFX marks the presentation of the sleep score. (6) A muffled mechanical clink of gym weights is layered under the narration during the exercise segment. (7) The BGM continues at a consistent volume as the speaker delivers a final encouraging message, ending with the music fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the FitHub app as an essential tool for achieving rapid fat loss through controlled diet, sleep tracking, and a balanced exercise routine. The video leverages the creator's physical transformation as social proof.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the app, demonstrates its features (photo recognition, nutrient tracking), and recommends it to viewers as part of a successful fat-loss strategy.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production-value fitness promotion using clear visual comparisons and data-driven advice to drive app downloads.
